combined_loss: L_synthetic + 0.25 * L_native; separate backwards accumulated before one clip and optimizer step
stream_policy: Every update retains identical four synthetic examples from matched control and adds four native examples; 4:1 loss weight, equal example counts; extra compute is disclosed
weight_rationale: One conservative native contribution, 20% of combined stream weight, preserves established synthetic anchor because only26 nonduplicate release triplets qualify; no lambda or ratio search
native_sampler: uniform available heart family, then uniform available lung family conditional on heart, then uniform triplet, then uniform valid aligned crop start0..28000 inclusive
native_target: No lag, no FIR. Heart=g*released_heart, lung=g*released_lung; shared positive g fixed from6-9s calibration. Input is original released mixture, never recomputed sum. Same8s crop for all three; divide all by cropped mixture peak.
native_augmentation: none beyond shared random valid crop; retain recorded relative source level; no artificial native remixes or source gain changes
native_target_tolerance: Both untouched full0-6s and9-15s flanks residual RMS <=0.10*weaker-source RMS; all selected observed <=0.0048. No reference residual redistribution.
fold_guard: Both native families must be in fold training; guard before hash/decode; no native heldout-family target preparation, gradient exposure, learned correction or statistics in training
validation: Existing frozen1775 synthetic conditions/8 heldout family pairs; same4k10s-window8s-hop evaluator; exact endpoint576 only

control.reuse_rule: Require same fresh model state hash, fold assignment, optimizer settings, first2304 realized synthetic recipes and frozen CV recipes. No historic narrow two-pair score comparison or baseline retraining.

adoption_gate.absolute_utility_gate: heart and lung macro SI-SDRi each>=1dB; every8 family-pair/source mean>=0dB; zero numerical failures
adoption_gate.rationale: Same engineering gate as prior data-expansion branch, fixed before native treatment;0.5dB exceeds twice observed~0.227dB primary/confirmation Q difference, not statistical significance. Two seeds cannot estimate population variance.

if_fail: STOP native branch; no rescue role/loss/weight/seed/capacity. Retain unchanged final_separator_v2. T9 remains sealed.

if_pass.final_initialization: fresh seed20260928, no fold checkpoint loading
if_pass.final_schedule: constant, no validation or early stopping
if_pass.strategy: same simultaneous synthetic+qualified-native objective and sampling as pilot; all eligible non-test pool already qualified, no hidden additional native population
if_pass.freeze: preserve v1/v2 bytes and checkpoints; create final_separator_v3 only after validPASS and final endpoint; synthetic load/shape/finite/consistency/zero checks; STOP beforeT9

unknowns: Late additive subset exact acquisition/generation process is undocumented
New file hashes do not establish new physiological subjects
No demographic inference inputs or clinical claims
stop_after: Native pilotFAIL retainingv2 OR validPASS finalv3; NEVER T9
